name: finance-invoice-approval
description: Accounts-payable control flow: an analyst validates an invoice (math, policy, supporting docs), then a router applies the approval matrix — small/clean invoices auto-approve, standard ones go to a manager, and high-value ones hit a LOCKED executive sign-off before any money moves. Showcases `route` as an approval matrix and `lock` as the accountable money-out-the-door gate.

inputs.name: invoice
inputs.description: The invoice to validate and approve (upload the PDF / document).

phases.name: validate
apply-approval-matrix
phases.description: auto = under the auto-approval threshold and clean. escalate = above the manager threshold → locked executive sign-off. default = standard manager review.

auto.name: auto-approve

escalate.name: executive-sign-off

default.name: manager-review
